info.name: State Department Consular Affairs Data Country Information API
Get travel information for all countries

items.docs: Returns detailed travel information for all countries, including transportation, entry/exit requirements, local laws, health guidance, safety and security advisories, destination descriptions, and embassy/consulate contact information. All content fields are HTML-formatted.

info.name: Get travel information for a specific country

params.name: tag
params.description: Two-letter country code (e.g., AF for Afghanistan, FR for France)

items.docs: Returns detailed travel information for a specific country identified by its two-letter country code tag. Includes transportation, entry/exit requirements, local laws, health guidance, safety and security advisories, destination descriptions, and embassy/consulate contact information.

info.name: Get a specific field of travel information for a country

params.name: field
params.description: Field name to retrieve (e.g., health, safety_and_security, entry_exit_requirements)

items.docs: Returns a specific field of travel information for a country identified by its two-letter code. Useful for retrieving only the relevant section (e.g., health, safety_and_security) without fetching the full record.
